description: Search several sources at once from a natural-language request when the right engine is unclear. Search1API picks up to five engines (web, Hacker News, Reddit, GitHub, X, arXiv, Wikipedia, and more) and a time window from the wording, then returns up to 10 citable results ranked by relevance, plus the intent it used and any engines that failed. Costs 5 credits per call; use search when you already know the engine.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in their own words; naming a platform ("on Reddit", "papers") or a period ("this week") steers which engines and time window are used

name: ask

errors.description: Engines that failed while others completed

intent.description: Keywords, engines, and time window that were used

time_range.description: Recency window inferred from the request, or null for any time

results.description: Up to 10 sources across the chosen engines, most relevant first

id.description: Stable identifier for this result; for web results this is the canonical URL

text.description: Result snippet or extracted page text when available

url.description: Canonical URL that clients can cite and users can open

title: Ask across sources
